name: Inpatient, Emergency Department, and Outpatient Visits for Respiratory Illnesses

columns.name: mmwr_week
columns.description: A weekly counting system within a calendar year standardized by the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

columns.name: week
columns.description: The calendar week standardized by the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

columns.name: week_start
columns.description: Beginning date of the MMWR week

columns.name: week_end
columns.description: Ending date of the MMWR week

columns.name: season
columns.description: Annually recurring reporting period for which estimates are calculated, beginning during MMWR week 40 and ending with week 39 of the following year

columns.name: data_source
columns.description: The U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention system that the data is obtained from

columns.name: essence_category
columns.description: The CDC National Syndromic Surveillance Program (NSSP) query name used in ESSENCE to generate the data in respiratory category column

columns.name: respiratory_category
columns.description: Shortened name for the ESSENCE category column

columns.name: percent
columns.description: Percent of total visits in the specified visit type and demographic group for the specified respiratory category

columns.name: activity_level
columns.description: Indicator of how much people are seeking healthcare in emergency departments for respiratory illnesses. Five levels range from minimal to very high

columns.name: current_week_ending
columns.description: Ending date of the the MMWR week for the current season
